issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וַחֲקָרוֹ' means 'and searches him' (i.e., the neighbor examines/probes the righteous person's case), but the Chinese renders it as '前來見弟兄' ('comes to see the brother'), which omits the concept of searching/examining and changes the action. The Hebrew has the neighbor coming and searching, not merely coming to see.
